info.name: Get loan/borrow positions for an address

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,arbitrum_one'). If omitted, returns loan positions across all supported chains.

params.name: address
params.description: The blockchain address to query loan positions for.

items.docs: Returns an overview of loaned/supplied/borrowed assets for a given address.

info.name: Get loan/borrow positions for an entity

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,arbitrum_one'). If omitted, returns loan positions across all supported chains.

params.name: entity
params.description: The entity ID to query loan positions for. Accepts both Arkham entity IDs and user entity IDs.

items.docs: Returns an overview of loaned/supplied/borrowed assets for a given entity.
